name: bitnet-b158-latency
description: Microsoft BitNet b1.58 — low-latency local serve for Akasha BitNetProvider
notes: Set RBITNET_MODEL and RBITNET_TOKENIZER to paths from rbitnet.manifest.json after `rbitnet models install microsoft-bitnet-b1.58-2b-4t`. Optional: set RBITNET_MODEL_SHA256 to the catalog sha256 and enable RBITNET_TRUSTED_MODELS_ONLY=1.
